literal_meaning: হাঁটা (walking) + চলা (moving) – walking and moving around
figurative_meaning_en: wandering here and there or moving about aimlessly
example_sentences_in_bangla: বুড়ো মানুষ অত হাঁটাচলা করতে পারেন না।
শহরে এত হাঁটাচলা করলে ক্লান্ত লাগবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Old people can't do that much walking around.
So much pacing about in the city will make you tired.
note: Synonymous with চলাফেরা, often used in contexts of physical activity limitations
